shared_elements: single frontal anthropomorphic figure occupying a tall vertical field
human head with headdress/cap-like upper element

justification: Both depict a single frontal standing human figure filling the whole height of an upright block, with the head at the top, arms folded or brought in against the chest, and no accompanying creatures or scene. The strongest divergence is in manner: A is a flat, low-relief composition with fine incised detailing and apparent horizontal panels of small sign-like elements along the base, whereas B is a fully rounded, massive body with heavy blocky facial features (bulging brows, broad nose, thick lips) and no secondary motifs at all.
